name: chowdary-2006
description:
From original source:
-----

The authors compared pairs of snap-frozen and RNAlater preservative-suspended tissue from lymph node-negative breast tumors (B) and Dukes' B colon tumors (C). Differently, we build our data set with purpose of separating B from C.

Chowdary: 62 B and 32 C

Parameters used in our filter:
Chowdary: l= 3 and c=26
creator: Dondapati Chowdary et al.
citation: Chowdary, Dondapati, Jessica Lathrop, Joanne Skelton, Kathleen Curtin, Thomas Briggs, Yi Zhang, Jack Yu, Yixin Wang, and Abhijit Mazumder. "Prognostic Gene Expression Signatures Can Be Measured in Tissues Collected in RNAlater Preservative." The Journal of Molecular Diagnostics: JMD 8, no. 1 (February 2006): 31-39.
